While armed with a lightsaber, adds 2 to his defense value. During battle, may lose 2 Force to add one battle destiny. Immune to attrition &lt; 6.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 of this alternate-image card in release order. Recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The Players Committee logo and the mark “(AI)” were added at the bottom right (the first image printed neither); nothing else visible changed. The PC published the same image the same day under a second file name, <code>anakinskywalkerjediknight_ai.gif</code>, which the PC card data uses.
